shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement; §34 walkable islands; §35 cross-plateau cost clamps. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~84 files, ~27,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Workshop item **3776015553** (public). See §31.

**⚠ §9's run log records AGENT-DRIVEN runs only.** The user tests tiers, utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router outside Modmixer.

**⚠⚠ THE THREE RULES THIS SESSION COST THE MOST TO LEARN:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC MAY SIT ON THE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER A TRANSIT HAPPENS** (§33c) - and its selection-side twin: **CLAMP AT SELECTION, NEVER AT MOVEMENT** (§35).
2. **NEVER PATCH `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - ~4,500 calls/frame; use `map.events.RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e).
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b). Anything answering "can this pawn walk there" must flood CELLS with the diagonal rule, never `Region.Neighbors`.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** **✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED (#294).**
**✅ §33 CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT WORKS END TO END (#302).** **✅ §33a PATH LINE FIXED (#305).**
**✅ §34 WALKABLE ISLANDS VERIFIED (#308).** Multi-building same-band routing works.
**🆕 §35 THREE CROSS-PLATEAU COST CLAMPS BUILT, UNVERIFIED:** same-island-first work selection, transit-leg heuristic floor, chain cache.
**⛔ §33c ENTRY ANIMATION REVERTED.** Pop-out only; `ReadyToCarry` BUILT, NOT WIRED.
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a, §33g BUILT, UNVERIFIED.** **🔧 §32a NEVER FIRED** (needs a raid). **🔧 §32c slider OFF (transit legs now floor at 1.35 regardless, §35b).**
**⚠ §34f OPEN RISKS: flood cost on wall-build UNMEASURED; band-1 9% walkable UNCONFIRMED BY EYE.**
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠⚠ AND THAT IS THE SOURCE OF §34.** `CanReach` answers "can I get there USING STAIRS"; the pathfinder answers "can I walk there NOW". **Every `CanReach=True` + `path=NOT FOUND` stall is that gap.**
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS** (§30).
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** **⚠⚠ AND ALREADY 100% UNPATHABLE IN EVERY MODE, INCLUDING FLYING. DO NOT "HARDEN" IT.** `PathGridDef Flying` exempts only `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, which `AB_OpenAir` does not set. **No movement bug here has ever come from a soft gutter.**
**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow`; the see-through click rule; the combat renderer. **§33b/§33f are the worked examples** for the open combat case.
**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`). **⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** **⚠ 318 blocked by arithmetic; 62 deliberately absent.** **⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID.** **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease.
**⚠⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS - THE SWEEP AND `PatherArrived` - AND NOTHING MAY GATE EITHER** (§33c).
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it.
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK: ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`** (Item, Plant, Filth). **Pawns DO shrink.**
**⚠ TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** HARD rule.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX CARRIES TWO EFFECTS, MULTIPLIED IN ONE POSTFIX.** No second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions; has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**
**OLD best:** #255 5x190 Boreal ~4.1 s. **NEW (all 5x126):** #278 **~1.6 s** | #277 ~3.4 s | **#294-#308 Mountainous ExtremeDesert ~3.1 s** (carve 1,998 ms, 1,575 `FillRock band 0`).
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size.** **⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** (21x). **⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED.** **⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING - OR PATHING - TEST IS VALID AT ALL** (fragmentation tracks it, §34f).
**⚠ `RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER.**
**9g.** 1. **Basement rock suppression**. 2. `GenStep_Plants` (demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS; THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The palette always strips its LAST entry. n=27.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR REPORT LINES ARRIVE AS `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US.** **Info is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE.** #297-#300: nothing logged while group movement was broken. What a clean run does prove: no `Skipped patch class` means every patch resolved.
**⚠⚠ ASK FOR THE EXISTING DIAGNOSTIC BEFORE THE FIRST GUESS.** Band info + stuck probe solved in two readings what three theories missed.
**⚠⚠ WHEN YOU CANNOT TELL WHICH PATCH DID IT, TRAP THE SHARED FUNNEL** (`AB2: trap vertical lines` on `GenDraw.DrawLineBetween`). Named a pre-existing duplicate patch in ONE run. **Keep it.**
**⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC MUST PRINT THE INTERMEDIATE VALUES, NOT THE VERDICT** (#307: three mutually contradicting facts named the design error).
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ COUNTER PAIRS THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK** (#294: 433 vs 432).

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the first theory.**
**⚠⚠ A DERIVED ANSWER CANNOT BE MORE ACCURATE THAN ITS SOURCE** (§34b). **Before building an index to catch a subsystem lying, check you are not building it out of the lie.**
**⚠⚠ ONE USER GESTURE CAN HAVE THREE CODE PATHS** (§33f). **Enumerate every handler before declaring a fix done.**
**⚠⚠ A COSMETIC EFFECT MUST NEVER SIT ON THE DECIDING PATH** (§33c). **⚠⚠ CLAMP AT SELECTION, NEVER AT MOVEMENT** (§35) - refusal at StartPath recreates the CanReach=True stall; refusal must happen before the job is taken.
**⚠⚠ WHEN THE REVERT DOES NOT FIX IT, THE HYPOTHESIS WAS WRONG - STOP EXTENDING IT.**
**⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT - AND WHETHER THE MISTAKE IS ALREADY DOCUMENTED.** Six times this session. **Grep for the target; read the neighbouring comments.**
**⚠ NOT EVERY BRANCH OF A FUNNEL LIES EQUALLY** (§35a). `ClosestThingReachable`'s regionwise BFS is island-aware for free (region hops go through the wormhole chain); only the euclidean global fallback lies. **Diagnose per branch before patching the whole funnel.**
**⚠ A THRESHOLD ON A FAST-PATH FLAG NEEDS A MINIMUM MAGNITUDE** (one-cell pocket set `anyFragmented`).
**⚠ VISIBILITY-GATE A MARKER, GEOMETRICALLY LIFT A CHAIN** (§33a).
**⚠ WHEN A CORE FEATURE REGRESSES, REVERT FIRST.**
**⚠ A CORRECT PRINCIPLE APPLIED TO THE WRONG THING IS STILL A BUG.**
**⚠ A GUARD THAT FIRES UNCONDITIONALLY IS NOT A GUARD THAT FIRES ON ITS TRIGGER.**
**⚠ WHEN YOU MAKE TWO THINGS AGREE, ASK WHICH ONE IS RIGHT.** **Coherence is not correctness.**
**⚠ "NOT SAME" IS NOT "KNOWN DIFFERENT".** **A three-valued answer needs a three-valued test.**
**⚠ AN ARITHMETIC SIGNATURE NAMES THE GUILTY METHOD** (one-Slot delta).
**⚠ FIXING A HELPER DOES NOT FIX ITS CALL SITES.** **⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO RIGHT** - the majority being correct is why the odd one survived.
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE FOUR DEFECTS** (§33a). **⚠ COPY A LOOP'S DIRECTION TOO** (`Peek(n)` ascends FORWARD). **⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTHLESS IF ITS INPUT NEVER CHANGES.** **⚠ REUSING A RADIUS IS REUSING ITS REASONS.**
**⚠ NEVER CALL A SYNCHRONOUS PATHFIND FROM A DRAW CALLBACK** (§33g).
**⚠ WHEN THE USER PROPOSES A FIX, CHECK WHETHER THE PREMISE IS ALREADY TRUE.** **Take the symptom seriously and the mechanism sceptically.**
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE PATCHED AND FAILS SILENTLY.** **A job holding MANAGED references IS patchable.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE CLAIM** (§32).
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING.**
**⚠ INSTRUMENTING THREE OF FIVE EARLY RETURNS IS THE SAME MISTAKE AS INSTRUMENTING NONE.**
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before untested claims reach player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE** - a GENERATED map may not (§34 needed a built fixture).
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** **⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS.** **⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, NOR n=4.**
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN REGRESS EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS.** **⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST.** **⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION IT WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ A comment gone FALSE is worse than none.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log the loudest error is downstream.**
**Patching.** **Wrap the DATA instead of the reader.** Patch the PRODUCER. Own the widget. **No foreign types in patch signatures; omit private nested structs - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state releases in a Finalizer.** **Detect-then-redo over always-redo** - and its selection twin: **local-pass-then-vanilla with a `[ThreadStatic]` latch** (§35a, §30-POWER shape; recursion without the latch is an UNCATCHABLE StackOverflow).
**⚠ PREFER A VANILLA EVENT TO A PATCH ON A HOT METHOD** (`RegionsRoomsChanged`).
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN** - you then own every branch, including the ones you did not notice.
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR Full-fillage. `TerrainHard` IGNORES vertex alpha; `renderQueue` AFTER shader. A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. Gensteps run with bookkeeping DEFERRED. Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. `FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray`. `Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back `_east`+`westFlipped`.
**⚠⚠ PATHING vs REGION FACTS (§34).** **A region is a CELL SET; path production ALSO refuses diagonal corners** (`PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement(x, z, pc, canBashFences)`). **`map.pathing.Normal` is the `PathingContext`; `PathGrid.WalkableFast` takes cell/index/x,z.** **`TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`: ~4,500 calls/frame, NEVER patch.** `Region.AnyCell` is inside the region; `extentsClose.CenterCell` is NOT. **A region never straddles the gutter.**
**⚠ SELECTION FACTS (§35).** **`GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable` is the work/haul funnel** and has two branches: regionwise BFS (region-hop metric, island-aware for free) and `ClosestThing_Global` (euclidean + CanReach only - the liar; fires when the BFS sees 30 regions without a hit or the group is not region-findable). **`Thing.PositionHeld` for candidates** - held things resolve to their holder. **Bills use `ClosestThing_Global_Reachable` and bypass this funnel.**
**⚠ ORDERING FACTS (§33f).** ONE pawn -> `PawnGotoAction` via `BestOrderedGotoDestNear`; TWO+ -> `MultiPawnGotoController` (owns destinations AND the ghost; `active` set only by `AddPawn`; `ProcessInputEvents` assigns `end = UI.MouseCell()` RAW).
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18: cached atlas blit ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix` - `disableCache`. `GetDrawParms` reaches WORKER THREADS - gate probes behind an int. A uniform x/z Scale right-multiplies; a TRANSLATION cannot.
**⚠ WALL-MOUNT FACTS.** Draw layer `Item`; south offset 0 vs N/E/W 0.9; **two unrelated wall-mount mechanisms in different cells** (`isAttachment` needs `supportsWallAttachments` which ordinary walls lack; `canPlaceOverWall` takes the wall's own cell); `isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` load-bearing.
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` PRIVATE; `ConnectMaxDist = 6`, no LOS; `TransmitsPowerNow` VIRTUAL, base ignores flicking; **a `private const` is INLINED - unreadable by reflection.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` deduped per VARIANT per tick (`Area`/`AvoidGrid` in the key). `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` (20 B/cell). `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS. **`PawnPath` is POOLED.** **`Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`.**
**⚠ `HashSet<T>` lacks non-generic `ICollection`.** **⚠ Core textures are PACKED; two art families** (Dubwise thick outline / VE nearly none).

# 35. CROSS-PLATEAU COST CLAMPS — BUILT, UNVERIFIED

**⚠⚠ THE PRINCIPLE: CLAMP AT SELECTION, NEVER AT MOVEMENT.** Refusal at StartPath/TrySegment recreates the `CanReach=True` re-issue stall §34 eliminated. A trip is declined BEFORE the job is taken, or not at all. **Rejected on those grounds: hop caps or budgets inside `CanReach`** (shared by rescue, firefighting, threat response - a downed colonist on another plateau would read unreachable and die).

## 35a. SAME-ISLAND-FIRST WORK SELECTION — `ABIslandWorkScope.cs`
Prefix on `GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable`, the funnel nearly every work giver and haul scan uses. **Two branches, only one lies:** the regionwise BFS counts REGION HOPS (through the wormhole chain - island-aware for free); the euclidean global fallback ranks a 15-cell-away plateau above a 60-cell same-island target that is 400 cells of walking.
**Pass 1** re-enters with the caller's validator wrapped: reject candidates on the SAME band but a DIFFERENT island (ours runs first - two array reads vs an arbitrarily expensive caller validator). Hit -> take it. Miss -> **pass 2 is vanilla untouched** (prefix returns true), so cross-island work still happens when nothing local exists.
**⚠ `[ThreadStatic]` LATCH, §30-POWER SHAPE** - the prefix re-enters the method it patches; recursion without the latch is an uncatchable StackOverflow.
**⚠ SCOPE: cross-BAND candidates untouched** (down-across-up logistics is the mod's core feature); **unknown islands untouched** (three-valued lesson). Gated on `FragmentedBandAt(root)` - one cached bool on a settled band.
**⚠ COST: a doubled scan when pass 1 misses.** **⚠ NOT COVERED: `ClosestThing_Global_Reachable`** (WorkGiver_DoBill ingredients) - extend only with evidence.
**Counters `localHits`/`fallbacks` print in `AB2: pathing report`.**

## 35b. TRANSIT-LEG HEURISTIC FLOOR — in `Patch_PathFinder_ABHeuristicStrength`
Legs of an in-flight segmented trip get `heuristicStrength >= 1.35` even with the player's slider at 1.00. **⚠ A FLOOR, NOT A CHANGED DEFAULT** - raising the shipped default would silently make ALL pathing greedier; this prices only the long hauls §34 newly enabled. **⚠ COMPOSED BY `max()` WITH THE SLIDER, NEVER MULTIPLIED** (2.5 x 1.35 would be an unrequested trade). Vanilla precedent: 1.5 darkness, 1.75 animals. A pending transit record identifies exactly the right legs: `TrySegment` creates it BEFORE the pather builds the leg's path; the final same-island leg after the last hop is correctly unboosted.

## 35c. CHAIN CACHE — in `ABWormhole.TryGetTransit`
`HopDistances` (the island-graph BFS) cached per destination island. **⚠ THE PAIR CHOICE IS DELIBERATELY NOT CACHED** - it depends on where the pawn stands, and freezing it would march every pawn to one stairwell past a nearer one. **⚠ INVALIDATION KEYS ON `ABBandComponents.Version` AND THAT COVERS BOTH CHANGE MODES:** island shape (region rebuild bumps it directly) and pair membership (stairs are edifices; building or destroying one dirties regions, raising the same event). No second version counter to keep honest.
